messages:
elaine: Heads-up — Tribeca (fintech) confirmed POC week of Apr 13. They need SSO (SAML) + SCIM + RBAC mapping. Looking for POC duration, list price, and blockers.

mike: I can lead the POC. Need IdP metadata (XML), SCIM service account + token, and sample user list (~5000 users?). Also confirm SP-initiated vs IdP-initiated.

vikram: For RBAC we support role-tags via SCIM 2.0 groups -> role mapping. If they need per-org domain allowlist, we have "domain controls" feature; it's opt-in for Private deployments.

sarah: Security ask: can we provide A) SAML signed assertions, B) cert rotation window, C) SCIM audit logs retention, D) data-at-rest encryption details. I'll draft answers for the sec questionnaire.

mike: Quick SCIM example for them:
curl -u "scim-service:LONGTOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/scim/v2/Users"
That endpoint is scoped to the customer's org on Dedicated/Private; hosted will be a tenant path.

vikram: SAML requirements: support SHA256 signatures, SP metadata endpoint, Optional: attribute mappings (email, name, employeeNumber). We also support IdP-initiated sessions and SSO session TTL config.

elaine: Pricing Q — they asked for 4-week POC with trial discount and reserved capacity for peak. Sales ops: what discount band is allowed for AE to approve?

mike: For a POC we can offer 50% credit on usage up to $10k and engineering support (8 hours) — subject to AM sign-off. Confirm if they want dedicated GPUs during POC.

idp-bot: POC ticket created: POC-482 — resources assigned: mike (SE), vikram (eng), sarah (security). Timeline set to 2026-04-13 -> 2026-05-11.

sarah: One blocker: corporate policy requires SCIM over mTLS or strong token auth. We support bearer tokens; mTLS is available for Private. Ask them if mTLS required.

elaine: I'll confirm IdP vendor (Okta/Azure AD/Ping?) and expected provisioning cadence. Also ask about nested groups — we support nested groups flattening in provisioning.

mike: Action items: 1) Elaine get IdP metadata + sample users by EOD Tue, 2) Sales ops confirm discount/PO, 3) Security to fill questionnaire draft by Wed.

elaine: noted. I'll ping them now and cc legal if they ask for DPA/DP transfer info. :thumbsup:
